text: Hello boys and girls, nice to see you again.In the last lesson, we read an article from Today, we'll continue to talk about it.By the end of the lesson, you will reach the aims as follows.Please get your textbook and worksheet ready.We can record our life in a diary.We can write about what we saw, what we heard, what we thought and how we felt in it.There are lots of activities we do every day.Shall we keep all the events in a diary?Paul had different activities in June.Let's see what he did.On June 25, he visited his grandparents as usual.On June 28, he and his dad helped the two women tourists deal with the trouble.On June 29, he finished all his homework.On June 30, he washed the dishes after dinner.Good job!If you were Paul, which event would you choose to write in the diary?Yes, the second one.Comparing to the others, this is an unusual thing happened to him.So, if we are going to write a diary, we should write something unusual.This is how we select a topic for a diary.Paul chose the topic of dealing with trouble in his diary.How did he record the event?He mentioned the following elements in his diary.Who was in trouble?Two women tourists, a young man, Paul and dad and the crowd.When did the trouble happen?On June 28.Where did the trouble take place?At the ferry station.What was the trouble?The women tourists met except.How was the trouble solved?Paul's dad helped the two women tourists deal with it.By answering these WH questions and how questions, we gather details of an event.Now, please read the sentences and rearrange them according to Paul's diary.Have you got your answers?What happened first?Paul and his dad heard a big argument when they were waiting for the ferry.Then, dad asked the women tourists what happened.After that, dad reported the theft to the police.Finally, the man was caught.As we can see, we can record the event in time order, just like Paul did.It can make the diary clear and logical.In Paul's diary, he wrote about what he saw, what he heard, what he thought and how he felt.Can you find these details in his diary?Now, take out your worksheet.Underline the details Paul wrote.It's on task 1.Two women tourists and a young man.What else?The man held out a bag and showed everyone that it was empty.What did Paul hear?A big argument and they were shouting at each other.What did he think during the event?Was my dad really afraid of that man?How did he feel?That was strange.He felt puzzled.From Paul's diary, we learned that we can use sensory details to organize details in a diary.Sensory details are important in descriptible writing.It is like painting a picture to the readers to help visualize the situation.They can make your diary vivid and attractive.Besides using sensory details in the diary, Paul also added dialogues in it.Can you find some?And what's the purpose for adding the dialogues?Let's look at some dialogues Paul added.Paul's dad said, what's going on?Why did Paul add this quote in the diary?To answer his dad's question, Paul added, Why did Paul add this quote in the diary?To ask for information.One of the women tourists answered him.Her answer is to add information in the diary.When the women tourist and the young man went aboard, Paul's dad said, Wait, let's take the next ferry.This dialogue showed his personality.We learned that he was a calm and wise man.When Paul's dad helped her catch the thief, Paul said, Well done dad!This is used for showing Paul's feelings.He felt proud of his dad.By adding dialogues in the diary, it will be readable and real to the readers.This is how we organize the details as well.Boys and girls, keeping a diary can help us to develop the habit of thinking.It also improves our writing ability.When keeping a diary, we should select a topic first.In Paul's diary, he wrote about an unusual thing, trouble.We should gather details in it.Don't forget to organize the details.We can record what we saw, what we heard, what we thought and how we felt in it.Class, in Paul's diary, who was in trouble?Yes, there were two women tourists.A young man, Paul and his dad and the crowd.Different people have different ways to deal with the trouble.How did they try to deal with it?Please take out your worksheet and complete the table in task two.Have you finished?Let's check.How did the two women tourists deal with the trouble?They argued with the young man and followed him aboard.What about the young man?He showed his bag was empty and hurried aboard.What did Paul and his dad do?They went to the shop nearby and reported the theft to the police.What about the crowd?They stared at the three people.Good job, class.Among these ways to deal with the trouble, which do you think was the best?Paul and dad really helped the women solve the trouble.It was the best way.I really appreciate Paul's dad.Do you agree with me?Let's listen to one of my students, Sam's idea.I agree with you.I think Paul's dad was really wise and careful.The way he dealt with the trouble showed his wisdom.He didn't panic like the women tourists.Instead, he kept calm all the time and tried to call the police and reported the theft in a safe way.This also showed he was a careful and thoughtful man.And unlike the crowd, he actually did something to help the women tourists deal with the trouble.He was really helpful.Thank you, Sam.Boys and girls, we have talked a lot about Paul's diary and how his father dealt with the theft.Let's make a conclusion.What can we learn from Paul's dad?Right, we should stay calm all the time, even if something terrible happened to you or to your friends.Remember to know how things happened from all aspects.What else can we learn from his dad?Yes, when we are determined to help others, we should have a clear mind, be thoughtful and considerate.Look for ways to deal with trouble in a wise and safe way.I think if everyone gives a helping hand, troubles will be solved.Class, here is a video clip about another trouble in life.Please watch it and think about what trouble it is.Please watch your belongings carefully when you are in public places.Why do you say that, Melody?Last Sunday, we went to the mall, and a thief stole my purse when we were eating at a cafe.Oh no!How did that happen?My family and I sat down, and I put my purse on an empty chair.When our food arrived, I looked around, and I found a bag full of food.Did anyone notice anything strange?My mother noticed a girl running out of the cafe with a purse similar to mine.We tried to follow her, but it was too crowded.Oh, Melody, that's terrible.What did you do?Did you dial the police?Yes, right away.I called them and told them what had happened and where I was.That's good.That's exactly what my parents say.So, did you get your purse back?I did.The police found the thief in a few hours.I was very lucky.What's the trouble in the video?It is about a theft in a cafe.Now class, please watch it again and find out the details of the theft.Who met a theft?When did it happen?Where did it take place?What happened?How was it solved?Ready?Last Sunday, we went to the mall and a thief stole my purse when we were eating in a cafe.When our food arrived, I looked around and saw that my purse was gone.The police know what to do in these situations.It's best to call them first.Have you gathered the details?Who met us at?Melody When did it happen?It happened last Sunday.In the mall What happened to Melody?A thief stole her purse How was it solved?She tried to follow the thief and called the police right away.Well done class.What can we learn from Melody's experience?Right, we should watch our belongings carefully when we are in public places.And we should call the police for help as soon as possible.Class, Paul's dad and Melody set good examples for us to deal with ourselves.But we sometimes meet different troubles in life.How will you deal with them if you happen to be in trouble?Now, we have two other troubles here.A car accident and a fire.These two troubles caused huge damage in our life.They were really scary.So how will you deal with them?Please take out your worksheet and think of possible ways to deal with them.That's task 3 on your worksheet.Do you have any ideas of how to deal with a car accident or a fire?If there is a car accident, I think you must call the police at once to report it.Pay attention, you should mention the place, the time and what happened about the accident.Meanwhile, you should dial 120 if somebody is hurt.If you can, you should also remember the license number of the cars and take photos to record the scene.You may provide the evidence to the police when they arrive.As to a fire, I suggest that you should stay calm all the time.Don't be panic.And if you can, you must call 119.Don't forget to wet some towels to cover your mouth and nose.What's more, don't take the lifts.These are only my suggestions for you if you meet such troubles.I believe you must have more safe and clever ways to deal with them.Class, today we talked about how to keep a diary and how to deal with the trouble in real life.I hope you enjoy it.Here is today's homework.This is the end of today's lesson.See you next time.Thank you for watching.
